semiconductor_relevance: High — Youwei specializes in semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment, which is critical for quality control in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Youwei Semiconductor Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. focuses on the R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment. The company aims to provide advanced process control solutions to enhance semiconductor manufacturing efficiency and quality.

regional_presence.China: Youwei is based in Suzhou Industrial Park and serves the global market from this location.
